summary: Iteration 149: Tested 3 new features - (1) Job sorting dropdown on Admin/Employer/Recruiter Jobs pages, (2) Candidate Bank mandate_id filter, (4) Employer Team Attendance page. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Feature 1 - Job Sorting: GET /api/jobs?sort_order=newest|oldest works for all roles (admin, employer, recruiter)
✅ Feature 1 - Job Sorting: JobSortDropdown component visible on Admin Jobs (/admin/jobs), Employer Jobs (/employer/jobs), Recruiter Jobs (/recruiter/jobs)
✅ Feature 1 - Job Sorting: Default sort is 'newest' (highest job IDs first)
✅ Feature 2 - Mandate Filter: GET /api/candidate-bank/?mandate_id=xxx filters candidates by mandate
✅ Feature 2 - Mandate Filter: Mandate dropdown visible in Candidate Bank filters panel with 'All Mandates' option
✅ Feature 4 - Team Attendance: GET /api/attendance/team/all returns team attendance for employer role
✅ Feature 4 - Team Attendance: GET /api/attendance/team/report/monthly returns monthly summaries for employer role

✅ Feature 4 - Team Attendance: EmployerTeamAttendancePage loads with stats cards, team summary table, and daily records
✅ Feature 4 - Team Attendance: 'Team Attendance' link visible in employer sidebar navigation
